name: stuff-manager
description: PACKAGE GUI — Local-first Developer Package Management Dashboard for macOS, Windows & Linux

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,web" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
